name: fixragent-mcp
description: Send a maintenance photo and get a Triage Profile back: what the asset is, whether a fault is visible, how urgent it is, and which trade to call.
long_description:
fixRAgent reads one photograph of a building asset and returns a Triage Profile as fixed JSON: what the asset is, whether a fault is visible in the photo, the severity and tier assigned in code from a published rubric, the trade required, and a sentence to say to the resident. Every reply carries the engine and rubric versions it was produced by, a diagnosis id, and a link to the profile.

The server exposes one tool, `triage_photo`, in front of the same public API the web door and the direct API callers use. It adds no second engine and no second prompt.

A key is required and is read from the `FIXRAGENT_API_KEY` environment variable. It is sent as the `x-triage-key` header and is never written to a file, to stdout or to stderr.

api_key.title: fixRAgent key
api_key.description: Your key, requested at https://fixragent.com/docs#key. Sent as the x-triage-key header on every call.
